bioaccumulation.def: The build-up of a substance in one organism over its lifetime, because it is taken in faster than it is broken down or excreted. Persistent, fat-soluble substances bioaccumulate.

biomagnification.def: The increase in concentration of a persistent, fat-soluble substance at each higher trophic level of a food chain, so top predators carry the highest levels.

methylmercury.def: A toxic form of mercury made by bacteria in water and sediment from mercury released mostly by burning coal. It bioaccumulates and biomagnifies in fish and harms the developing nervous system.
